indexes.//: GET /v1/:appId/itineraries — the app's trip list (routes/itineraries.ts:22). Equality on userId + orderBy updatedAt needs a composite index; without it Firestore returns 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION, which the api surfaces as a bare 500.
GET /v1/:appId/admin/itineraries?userId= — the admin panel's list (routes/admin.ts:151). Same shape, different sort field.
GET /v1/:appId/reviews?locationId= — public reviews for a site (routes/reviews.ts:64). locIdFieldFor() resolves to locationId because completion is disabled.
